title: The GTM Platform internal design system
author: Amal Irgashev
note: Signatures per component. The index is agent/index.json; the rules file for a component repeats its table in prose.

PromptInput.name: meta
PromptInput.type: { model: string; effort: string; attachments: File[] }

PromptInput.name: enableVoice
PromptInput.doc: When false (default), mic is decorative-only and never calls getUserMedia.

Alert.name: tone
Alert.doc: Which of the five state pairs this message belongs to.

Alert.name: icon
Alert.doc: Optional leading glyph; rendered through `<Icon>` at the 16px slot.

Avatar.name: name
Avatar.doc: The person. Labels the avatar, derives the initials, and seeds the tone.

Avatar.name: size
Avatar.doc: Ladder slot: 24 conversation / 32 row / 48 identity block.

Avatar.name: src
Avatar.doc: Optional portrait; falls back to the initials if it fails to load.

Avatar.name: tone
Avatar.doc: Pins the fill instead of hashing it, for surfaces that read tint as status.

Surface.name: bg
Surface.doc: Surface fill; the only fills app code can express.

Surface.name: ink
Surface.doc: Text colour for the subtree; the only inks app code can express.

Surface.name: border
Surface.doc: Hairline weight; both weights draw a 1px border.

Inline.name: wrap
Inline.doc: Allow items to wrap onto more than one line.

Variant.name: loading
Variant.doc: Work is in flight: the control locks, announces itself busy, and spins.

CheckboxGroup.name: label
CheckboxGroup.doc: Names the group above its rows.

CheckboxGroup.name: description
CheckboxGroup.doc: One line under the label, measure-capped.

CheckboxGroup.name: allValues
CheckboxGroup.doc: Every item value, in order. Only a select-all row needs it.

CheckboxGroupItem.name: value
CheckboxGroupItem.doc: The value this row contributes to the group.

CheckboxGroupItem.name: name
CheckboxGroupItem.doc: Submitted with a form; defaults to the value.

Combobox.name: value
Combobox.doc: The selected option's value. Omit for an empty picker.

Combobox.name: open
Combobox.doc: Controlled popup state. Omit and the picker owns it.

ComboboxTrigger.name: placeholder
ComboboxTrigger.doc: Shown, quietly, while nothing is selected.

ComboboxItem.name: value
ComboboxItem.doc: The value published to `onValueChange`. Never the label.

CommandList.name: viewportClassName
CommandList.doc: Classes for the scrolling box. The height bound lives here, not on the list.

DatePickerBase.name: placeholder
DatePickerBase.doc: Shown, quietly, while nothing is picked.

DatePickerBase.name: open
DatePickerBase.doc: Controlled popup state. Omit and the picker owns it.

FadeText.name: lines
FadeText.doc: Meta-rung lines. Two is the preview.

FadeText.name: render
FadeText.doc: Defaults to a paragraph. A card button must pass a span.

FramePanel.name: fit
FramePanel.doc: Size the panel to its content instead of letting it fill the frame.

IconWell.name: label
IconWell.doc: Accessible name when the well stands alone.

Icon.name: icon
Icon.doc: A glyph from `./glyphs`, passed as a reference.

Icon.name: label
Icon.doc: Set only when the icon carries meaning on its own; otherwise it is decorative.

InputCopy.name: value
InputCopy.doc: The value shown and copied. Read-only by construction.

InputCopy.name: label
InputCopy.doc: Names the field above it, and the copy button through it.

InputCopy.name: onCopy
InputCopy.doc: Fired only when the value actually reached the clipboard.

MarkdownEditor.name: flush
MarkdownEditor.doc: Remove nested field chrome when the editor already sits in a Frame panel.

MarkdownEditor.name: size
MarkdownEditor.doc: `document` is the writing surface for a prompt step. `field` is a compact slot.

MentionChip.name: kindLabel
MentionChip.doc: Kind heading shown in the peek (Accounts, Campaigns, …).

MentionChip.name: peek
MentionChip.doc: Show the hover peek. Default true.

MentionChip.name: onRemove
MentionChip.doc: When set, an × appears to dismiss the chip.

Orb.name: activity
Orb.doc: What the agent is doing. The map, not the call site, picks the animation.

Orb.name: className
Orb.doc: Placement only. The orb owns its own geometry and has no colour to set.

OrbStatus.name: activity
OrbStatus.doc: What the agent is doing. Also picks the default caption.

OrbStatus.name: size
OrbStatus.doc: `inline` beside the verb (thread), `avatar` for a standalone mark.

Progress.name: value
Progress.doc: How far along, from 0 to `max`. Clamped; ignored when indeterminate.

Progress.name: max
Progress.doc: The top of the range. Defaults to a percentage.

Progress.name: indeterminate
Progress.doc: Work is running with no known extent.

Progress.name: label
Progress.doc: What is progressing; announced, since a bar has no text of its own.

ScrollBar.name: reveal
ScrollBar.doc: `always` pins the thumb visible; the track stays invisible either way.

ScrollArea.name: viewportRef
ScrollArea.doc: The scrolling element, for a consumer that reads scroll offsets itself.

ScrollArea.name: recoveryKey
ScrollArea.doc: Stable product region identity; transient popups do not opt in.

ScrollArea.name: scrollbars
ScrollArea.doc: `hover` (default) or the standing thumb wide data may opt into.

SearchInput.name: size
SearchInput.doc: Placement picks the size: `compact` inside a frame, `control` in a toolbar.

SearchInput.name: value
SearchInput.doc: The query. Controlled: this field holds no state of its own.

SearchInput.name: shortcut
SearchInput.doc: One key to draw as a hint while the field is empty, e.g. "/".

Variant.name: variants
Variant.doc: The one close Base UI reports that is a confirmation rather than a dismissal.

Shortcut.name: apple
Shortcut.doc: Force Apple (⌘) or not. Omit to detect. Tests pass this.

Variant.name: variants
Variant.doc: How many step dots may be drawn before the rail turns into a comb.

Slider.name: label
Slider.doc: Names the slider above the rail. Omit it and pass `thumbLabels` instead.

Slider.name: showValue
Slider.doc: Shows the value opposite the label, in the mono face.

Slider.name: editable
Slider.doc: Turns the readout into a number field on click. Single-value sliders only.

Slider.name: showSteps
Slider.doc: Draws a notch at every step, up to 24 of them.

Slider.name: formatValue
Slider.doc: Units, currency, days: whatever makes the number mean something.

Slider.name: thumbLabels
Slider.doc: One accessible name per thumb. A range needs two ("From", "To").

StatusLabel.name: label
StatusLabel.doc: The word showing now. Driven by state, never by a timer.

StatusLabel.name: pending
StatusLabel.doc: True while the work behind the label is in flight.

Spinner.name: label
Spinner.doc: Set only when the spinner is the only sign that work is running.

Table.name: container
Table.doc: False hands overflow back to the consumer; see the note at the container.

AgentThreadRail.name: onDropThread
AgentThreadRail.doc: One principal-scoped label update for a completed thread drag.

AgentThreadRail.name: leading
AgentThreadRail.doc: Rail chrome above features — typically PostureBar.

AgentThreadRail.name: groupBy
AgentThreadRail.doc: Grouping owned by the Group control — not Tabs.

AgentTurn.name: name
AgentTurn.doc: Accessible label for the agent's turn.

UserTurnCopy.name: displayText
UserTurnCopy.doc: Visible prose and compact pill labels, when different from the full copy text.

UserTurn.name: copyText
UserTurn.doc: Source string for the hover copy. String children supply it.

NavigationRail.name: sidebar
NavigationRail.doc: Destinations (normally SidebarNav). Omit to mount no rail.

NavigationRail.name: railHeader
NavigationRail.doc: Brand row: logo + name + collapse. Pinned above the scroll.

NavigationRail.name: railFooter
NavigationRail.doc: Identity foot. Pinned below the scroll — person chrome, not a nav list.

NavigationRail.name: railCollapsed
NavigationRail.doc: Narrow the rail to the 48px icon width. Focus mode ignores this.

FocusShell.name: railFooter
FocusShell.doc: Same identity / settings foot as the product rail, pinned under the list.

CapacityMeter.name: remaining
CapacityMeter.doc: Remaining capacity. Clamped only for meter presentation.

CapacityMeter.name: limit
CapacityMeter.doc: Maximum capacity for the displayed window.

CapacityMetric.name: icon
CapacityMetric.doc: Product glyph shown in the standard icon well.

CapacityMetric.name: remaining
CapacityMetric.doc: Remaining capacity, omitted only when unavailable.

CapacityMetric.name: limit
CapacityMetric.doc: Maximum capacity for the primary window, omitted only when unavailable.

CapacityMetric.name: meterLabel
CapacityMetric.doc: Accessible metric and window label for the meter.

CapacityMetric.name: detail
CapacityMetric.doc: Optional next-available time when capacity is zero.

CapacityMetricGrid.name: label
CapacityMetricGrid.doc: Accessible name for the capacity set.

ChangeFeed.name: collapsedCount
ChangeFeed.doc: Rows rendered on the page; View more reveals the rest in the same list.

ComingUpCalendar.name: mode
ComingUpCalendar.doc: Controlled from the section header. Default is the list.

ComingUpCalendar.name: defaultRange
ComingUpCalendar.doc: First range when Calendar is opened. Tests may start on month.

DecisionList.name: children
DecisionList.doc: `DecisionRow` elements, in the order the server ranked them.

ChangeSet.name: title
ChangeSet.doc: Optional card label above the rows, e.g. "Changes".

EmptyState.name: action
EmptyState.doc: Recovery controls — omit when the surface already owns the next step.

FilterableTable.name: getRowId
FilterableTable.doc: Stable server id per row. Never the array index.

FilterableTable.name: title
FilterableTable.doc: The section's name, first on the toolbar row. For a table that is its section's whole body.

FilterableTable.name: tabs
FilterableTable.doc: Quick filters as a segmented tab strip, left of search.

FilterableTable.name: search
FilterableTable.doc: Omit for a table with no search field.

FilterableTable.name: onReset
FilterableTable.doc: One URL update clears all filters and search, preserving grouping and sorting.

FilterableTable.name: serverSorting
FilterableTable.doc: Only these columns can order the complete server result before pagination.

FilterableTable.name: facets
FilterableTable.doc: Faceted multi selects, left to right after the search field. Small client tables only.

FilterableTable.name: scopes
FilterableTable.doc: Server scopes as leftover dropdowns. New surfaces use `filters`.

FilterableTable.name: filters
FilterableTable.doc: Command popover of column filters. Writes request state; does not filter mounted rows.

FilterableTable.name: groupBy
FilterableTable.doc: Puts Group by on the right with Filters. Omit to leave the table flat.

FilterableTable.name: serverGrouping
FilterableTable.doc: Exact server group summaries plus the rows loaded for the one expanded group.

FilterableTable.name: gallery
FilterableTable.doc: Alternate layout of a catalog, sharing this toolbar and server-paged rows.

FilterableTable.name: actions
FilterableTable.doc: Surface action after Columns, aligned to the fixed toolbar's right edge.

FormField.name: help
FormField.doc: The field's permanent explanation, under the control.

FormField.name: required
FormField.doc: Marks the label and sets aria-required. Native validation stays off.

FormSection.name: titleId
FormSection.doc: Optional id on the title span, so a control inside can point at it.

FormSection.name: description
FormSection.doc: One or two lines of context for the group, above the first field.

FormSection.name: descriptionId
FormSection.doc: Optional id on the description, so a control inside can point at it.

FormSection.name: children
FormSection.doc: FormField children, at the one gap.

InputRequestComposer.name: onAskQuestion
InputRequestComposer.doc: Sets the form aside so the person can ask a question; the host saves and hides it.

InputRequestComposer.name: step
InputRequestComposer.doc: The current section, when the host keeps it across the form being set aside.

MetricCard.name: title
MetricCard.doc: Clear metric name. Rendered as the card heading.

MetricCard.name: value
MetricCard.doc: Preformatted value. Formatting remains with the data owner.

MetricCard.name: detail
MetricCard.doc: Window, coverage, or certainty for this specific reading. Omit when the info slot carries it.

MetricCard.name: icon
MetricCard.doc: Product glyph shown in the standard IconWell.

MetricCard.name: info
MetricCard.doc: Provenance disclosure trigger, end of the title band. See rule 7.

MetricCard.name: sparkline
MetricCard.doc: Word-sized trend of the same stored series, beside the value. See rule 8.

MetricCard.name: onDrill
MetricCard.doc: Makes the whole card open its own series at full resolution. See rule 9.

MetricCard.name: drillLabel
MetricCard.doc: Accessible name for the drill trigger. Names the series, not the gesture.

MetricCard.name: onOpen
MetricCard.doc: Makes a card with no sparkline open the collection its value counts. See rule 10.

MetricCard.name: openLabel
MetricCard.doc: Accessible name for the open trigger. Names the collection, not the gesture.

MetricCard.name: emphasis
MetricCard.doc: How large the value is set: the title rung by default, the display rung for a page's key numbers.

MetricCardGrid.name: label
MetricCardGrid.doc: Accessible name for the metric set.

MetricCardGrid.name: columns
MetricCardGrid.doc: Peak column count. The grid still collapses on a narrower container.

OverflowTabs.name: label
OverflowTabs.doc: Accessible name for the visible tablist.

PageBandLineage.name: lineage
PageBandLineage.doc: Root first; the last entry is the object the route is on.

PageBandLineage.name: onBack
PageBandLineage.doc: Where back goes. Omit only when the route genuinely has no parent.

PageBandLineage.name: backLabel
PageBandLineage.doc: Spoken by the back control; name the destination, not the direction.

PageBandLineage.name: action
PageBandLineage.doc: The one action that belongs to this object. Not a toolbar.

PageBandToolbar.name: children
PageBandToolbar.doc: Verbs fused with filters, left to right, all at the control rung.

PageSection.name: icon
PageSection.doc: Decorative. The heading text stays the accessible name.

PageSection.name: description
PageSection.doc: One or two lines at most; longer belongs in the section's body.

PageSection.name: actions
PageSection.doc: Section level controls, trailing the heading.

PageFrame.name: description
PageFrame.doc: One line. A second line means it wanted to be a section.

PageFrame.name: actions
PageFrame.doc: Header trailing controls; at most one primary on the surface.

PageFrame.name: children
PageFrame.doc: The page's sections, in the order they should appear.

PageFrame.name: dangerZone
PageFrame.doc: Destructive controls. Rendered last, after children, always.

PageMasthead.name: title
PageMasthead.doc: The page's one `text-page` element. Nothing else on the route may take it.

PageMasthead.name: description
PageMasthead.doc: One line, two rungs down. Longer is a section.

PageMasthead.name: icon
PageMasthead.doc: Feature glyph on the title row. Orientation, not a verb.

PageMasthead.name: counts
PageMasthead.doc: Readings of the page's contents. Rendered Quiet, never Urgent.

PostureControl.name: agentAttention
PostureControl.doc: Show the 6px unread dot on the Agent segment.

ProviderMark.name: data-testid
ProviderMark.doc: Test hook forwarded to the well.

QueueRow.name: primary
QueueRow.doc: The thing the row is about: an account, a person, a campaign target.

QueueRow.name: secondary
QueueRow.doc: The qualifier that identifies it: channel, owner, stage. Never truncated.

QueueRow.name: summary
QueueRow.doc: The reason this row is in the queue. This is what gives way when space runs out.

QueueRow.name: density
QueueRow.doc: 40px for scanning volume, 44px when each row carries an identity and a reason.

QueueRow.name: unread
QueueRow.doc: Weight plus the dot. Never a colour on its own.

QueueRow.name: selected
QueueRow.doc: The fill and `aria-selected`. One row per queue wears it.

QueueRow.name: selectable
QueueRow.doc: Mounts the checkbox lane. Pass it to every row in a queue or to none of them.

QueueRow.name: checkboxLabel
QueueRow.doc: Spoken by the checkbox; name the row, not the act ("Select Bosch").

QueueRow.name: state
QueueRow.doc: One `Badge`. The lane is reserved whether or not this row has a state.

QueueRow.name: meta
QueueRow.doc: The trailing timestamp or count. One lane, fixed width, right aligned.

QueueRow.name: action
QueueRow.doc: The one action, an icon `Button`. Revealed on hover and on focus.

QueueList.name: multiSelect
QueueList.doc: True when the rows carry checkboxes, so more than one row can be selected.

QueueList.name: children
QueueList.doc: `QueueRow` elements, in the order the product ranks them.

Receipt.name: titleClassName
Receipt.doc: Semantic type-rung override for conversation-scale outcomes.

Receipt.name: mark
Receipt.doc: Optional 24px IconWell or ProviderMark naming the result family.

Receipt.name: spacing
Receipt.doc: Panel padding rung. Agent-thread receipts use sm; full artifacts default.

RecordFact.name: copyable
RecordFact.doc: Hover and focus reveal Copy in the value lane. String values only.

RecordFact.name: expandable
RecordFact.doc: Long copy expands in the value lane. String values only.

RecordFact.name: edit
RecordFact.doc: Mounts only after the fact expands. Collapsed copy stays text.

ReviewBand.name: actions
ReviewBand.doc: Trailing verbs. Compact controls. Never composed into the title row.

ReviewBand.name: mark
ReviewBand.doc: Leading IconWell or brand mark. Omit when the section title already named the kind.

ReviewBand.name: meta
ReviewBand.doc: Facts under the copy: time, campaign, targets. Always `text-meta`.

ReviewBand.name: render
ReviewBand.doc: Swap the root for a button or link when the whole band is the control.

ReviewBand.name: titleClassName
ReviewBand.doc: Semantic type-rung override for conversation-scale objects.

SettingRow.name: description
SettingRow.doc: One line. Two lines means this wanted to be a section.

SettingRow.name: badge
SettingRow.doc: Rides inline with the label. Never in the control lane.

SettingRow.name: control
SettingRow.doc: The row's ONE control, given the row's id, save callback, and aria wiring.

SettingSection.name: description
SettingSection.doc: One or two lines at most; longer belongs in the rows themselves.

SettingSection.name: actions
SettingSection.doc: Section level controls, trailing the heading.

SettingSection.name: id
SettingSection.doc: Anchor id for the settings scoped rail. Forwarded to PageSection.

SettingSection.name: children
SettingSection.doc: SettingRow children, in the order the ticket lists them.

SidebarNavRow.name: href
SidebarNavRow.doc: Renders an anchor; without it the row is a button.

SidebarNavRow.name: selected
SidebarNavRow.doc: The fill, the ink and the weight, and `aria-current`. One row per rail.

SidebarNavRow.name: count
SidebarNavRow.doc: Unread or open work behind this destination. Zero is not a count.

SidebarNavRow.name: countOverflow
SidebarNavRow.doc: The source has more work than the bounded count can publish.

SidebarNavRow.name: attentionDot
SidebarNavRow.doc: New content since acknowledgement. Mutually exclusive with count.

SidebarNavChild.name: icon
SidebarNavChild.doc: Optional 16px mark for the destination; spine still owns nesting.

SidebarNavItem.name: icon
SidebarNavItem.doc: Parents carry icons; the prop is required so no rail grows two lanes.

SidebarNavItem.name: children
SidebarNavItem.doc: SidebarNavChild rows under an optional disclosure.

SidebarNavItem.name: preview
SidebarNavItem.doc: Context card for the icon-only row. Expanded destinations show their labels directly.

SidebarNavItem.name: onPreviewOpenChange
SidebarNavItem.doc: Lets the host start and stop a shared, lazy preview read.

SidebarNavGroup.name: label
SidebarNavGroup.doc: The category name. A group is not a destination, so it takes no href.

SidebarNavGroup.name: count
SidebarNavGroup.doc: How many rows are inside it. Zero is not a count.

SidebarNavGroup.name: open
SidebarNavGroup.doc: Controlled: whoever owns the URL owns which groups are open.

SidebarNavGroup.name: children
SidebarNavGroup.doc: SidebarNavChild rows, revealed by the disclosure.

SidebarNavSection.name: label
SidebarNavSection.doc: The family name. A section is not a destination.

SidebarNavCluster.name: label
SidebarNavCluster.doc: Optional family name rendered as SidebarNavSection.

SidebarNavCluster.name: divider
SidebarNavCluster.doc: Hairline above a role-gated family after daily work.

SidebarNav.name: label
SidebarNav.doc: Names the landmark. "Primary" on the app rail.

SplitViewBase.name: workPane
SplitViewBase.doc: Where the decision happens. Keeps its width in every posture.

SplitViewBase.name: posture
SplitViewBase.doc: `docked` is the 420px agent dock case: the yielding pane narrows.

SplitViewReference.name: referencePane
SplitViewReference.doc: What the decision is made against. This is the pane that yields.

SplitViewReference.name: referenceLabel
SplitViewReference.doc: Names the reference landmark, e.g. "Account context".

SplitViewReference.name: referenceResizable
SplitViewReference.doc: Drag the leading seam to resize the open rail (clamped 280–640).

SplitViewList.name: listLabel
SplitViewList.doc: Names the list landmark, e.g. "Inbox conversations".

SplitViewList.name: listResizable
SplitViewList.doc: Drag the seam to resize the open list width (clamped 200–520).

StatReadout.name: label
StatReadout.doc: The metric, as a noun. "Open pipeline", "Replies this week".

StatReadout.name: value
StatReadout.doc: Pre-formatted by the data layer. Null, undefined, or "" renders the em-dash.

StatReadout.name: shape
StatReadout.doc: 28px rail row, 40px key/value row, or 66px grid cell.

StatReadout.name: delta
StatReadout.doc: Sign glyph plus tone. Never colour alone.

StatReadoutGrid.name: label
StatReadoutGrid.doc: Names the group for assistive tech. "Run snapshot", "Account totals".

StatReadoutGrid.name: columns
StatReadoutGrid.doc: 2, 3, or 4. The boards draw 4; wider than that is a table.

StateNotice.name: title
StateNotice.doc: What happened, in the user's words: "This address is on the do-not-email list".

StateNotice.name: description
StateNotice.doc: One sentence of evidence and what it means for their work. It does not repeat the title.

StateNotice.name: tone
StateNotice.doc: Who clears it: RISK nobody here, ATTENTION a person, INFO time.

StateNotice.name: action
StateNotice.doc: The one thing the user can do about it here, or nothing.

TableFilters.name: trigger
TableFilters.doc: Outline labeled trigger on a table toolbar. Icon-only on a list chrome.

TableFilters.name: tabs
TableFilters.doc: My / All lives here, not as a column in the list.

TableFilters.name: catalog
TableFilters.doc: Account search + roster list under the tabs.

TableFilters.name: catalogs
TableFilters.doc: Independent remote catalogs for surfaces with more than one relationship filter.

VersionedEditor.name: leading
VersionedEditor.doc: Replaces the static version title when the surface owns a picker.

VersionedEditor.name: collapsed
VersionedEditor.doc: Same card, shorter body. The full prompt uses the expanded body.

VersionedEditor.name: onChromeToggle
VersionedEditor.doc: Click empty chrome to expand or collapse. Interactive children stop this.

VersionedEditor.name: diff
VersionedEditor.doc: ChangeSet / DiffRow comparison against live, revealed by the toolbar.

VersionedEditor.name: gate
VersionedEditor.doc: Optional PublishGate rendered as the stacked footer panel.

PublishGate.name: onDiscard
PublishGate.doc: Destructive: always routed through ConfirmableAction, never a bare click.

PublishGate.name: dryRun
PublishGate.doc: Reserved slot for the dry-run fast-follow. Quiet action, never a primary.

DataGridColumnHeader.name: title
DataGridColumnHeader.doc: When omitted, uses `column.columnDef.meta.headerTitle`, then a string `columnDef.header`, then `column.id`.

DataGridColumnHeader.name: pinnable
DataGridColumnHeader.doc: Reserved; pin controls are gated by tableLayout.columnsPinnable + column.getCanPin().

DataGridPagination.name: showSizes
DataGridPagination.doc: Hide the page-size picker (cursor-paged lists: the server owns the size).

DataGridTableVirtual.name: scrollBehavior
DataGridTableVirtual.doc: Scroll animation used when revealing a controlled target row.

DataGridTableVirtual.name: scrollToRowAlign
DataGridTableVirtual.doc: Alignment used when revealing a controlled target row. Defaults to auto.

DataGridTableVirtual.name: scrollToRowIndex
DataGridTableVirtual.doc: Index within the center (non-pinned) row section to reveal.

DataGrid.name: isRowClickable
DataGrid.doc: Narrows row click affordance when only some leaf kinds are interactive.

DataGrid.name: isRowFresh
DataGrid.doc: Tints the rows a live list just received or changed, for one paint.

DataGrid.name: selectedRowId
DataGrid.doc: Marks the leaf whose inspector is open. Group rows never match.
